title: Quick Start Guide
content:
Welcome to Vault! Here is the fastest way to set up and secure your digital life:

1. Create Your First Item: Tap the large '+' icon or press 'A' on your physical keyboard. Select a category (Login, Card, Bank, Note, Identity, WiFi) and fill in the details.
2. Enable Biometrics: Go to Settings > Security > Biometric Unlock to link your master password to your fingerprint or face ID.
3. Save Recovery Phrase: Go to Settings > Security > Recovery Phrase to record your 12-word master key. This is the ONLY way to regain access if you forget your master password.
4. Organize & Filter: Use category rows on the Home screen or the search bar at the top to filter items instantly.

title: Welcome & Security Overview
content:
Vault is a local-first, zero-cloud security and privacy manager built to keep your data completely offline and encrypted under your control:

• Zero Internet Access: Vault contains zero internet permissions. It is physically impossible for your credentials or photos to leak to an external server.
• Military-Grade Encryption: All passwords, notes, and media are encrypted locally using AES-256 via SQLite3MC and Android KeyStore.
• Private PhotoVault: Dedicated encrypted vault space for sensitive photos, videos, and documents with screenshot protection.
• Security Health Audit: Real-time analysis of weak passwords, reused credentials, incomplete identity documents, and upcoming expiries.

title: Dashboard Layouts & PhotoVault Hero
content:
Customize your Home screen layout in **Settings > Appearance > Home Screen Style**:

• Bento Grid Layout: Modern Material 3 modular layout with PhotoVault Hero card, Security Radar score, Secret Snap camera shortcut, and Vault AI assistant.
• Dual-Hub Layout: Split-view hub with a top switcher allowing 1-tap toggling between 'Credentials & Passwords' and 'PhotoVault & Media' views.
• Modern Layout: High-density card interface featuring Quick Access menu for Backup, Restore, Share, and Secret Snap.
• Classic Layout: Traditional list interface focused on categories and items.
• Hold to Peek: On Bento and Dual-Hub dashboards, touch and hold the PhotoVault Hero card to decrypt and preview sensitive media. Releasing your finger restores the privacy blur shield.
• Secret Snap Shortcut: Tap 'Secret Snap' on the home dashboard to launch the system camera directly. Photos captured are encrypted and saved straight into PhotoVault without saving to the public gallery.

title: Security & Protection Settings Menu
content:
Configure advanced vault security options in **Settings > Security**:

• Biometric Unlock: Go to **Settings > Security > Biometric Unlock** to enable fingerprint or face unlock.
• Stealth Mode (Disguise): Go to **Settings > Security > Stealth Mode** to turn ON. Disguises the Vault app icon and title as a functional 'Calculator'. To unlock, enter your secret PIN sequence (e.g. 123+456) and press '=' on the calculator keypad.
• Decoy Vault: Go to **Settings > Security > Decoy Vault** to enable. Creates a secondary 'Fake' vault with its own master password to show dummy records if forced to unlock.
• Intruder Selfie: Go to **Settings > Security > Intruder Selfie** to turn ON. Takes a silent front-camera photo after 3 failed login attempts and logs timestamps in Break-in Logs.
• Lock on Background: Go to **Settings > Security > Lock on Background**. Automatically locks database immediately whenever you switch away or close the app.
• Screenshot Protection: Go to **Settings > Security > Screenshot Protection** to prevent screen recording and screenshots across all screens.
• Recovery Phrase: Go to **Settings > Security > Recovery Phrase** to view your 12-word master key.
• Autofill Service: Go to **Settings > Security > Autofill Service** to set Vault as your default Android autofill provider.

title: Appearance & Theme Settings Menu
content:
Personalize the look and feel of Vault in **Settings > Appearance**:

• App Theme: Go to **Settings > Appearance > Theme** to switch between 'Modern Warm', 'Midnight Dark', 'Spiderman / Spider Web', 'High-Contrast Light', or 'System Default'.
• Home Screen Style: Go to **Settings > Appearance > Home Screen Style** to choose between Classic, Modern, Bento Grid, and Dual-Hub dashboard layouts.
• Background Styles: Go to **Settings > Appearance > Background Design** to select Solid Prism, Vault Mesh, Blurred Scrim, or a Custom Image from your phone gallery.
• Category Icon Shapes: Go to **Settings > Appearance > Icon Shape** to choose between Rounded, Square/Sharp, Circular, or Squircle (Smooth) category icon borders.

title: Data Management & Backups Menu
content:
Manage backups, recovery, and trash in **Settings > Data Management**:

• Backup Vault (.vault): Go to **Settings > Data Management > Backup Vault** to create an AES-256 encrypted file protected by a custom backup password.
• Restore Vault: Go to **Settings > Data Management > Restore Vault** to import entries from a `.vault` file. Choose 'Merge' to combine data or 'Replace' for full device migrations.
• Export ZIP Archive: Export selected files or gallery media as an encrypted or compressed ZIP archive to external storage with customizable compression quality.
• AutoScan Folders: Set Vault to monitor specific device directories for automatic encrypted import.
• Recycle Bin (Trash): Go to **Settings > Data Management > Recycle Bin** to view deleted entries. Restore items or set Auto-Clean duration (1 to 90 days or Never).
• Recent Backups: Go to **Settings > Data Management > Recent Backups** to view automatic local recovery points.

title: AI & Automation Settings Menu
content:
Configure private on-device AI features in **Settings > AI & Automation**:

• Select Custom AI Model: Go to **Settings > AI & Automation > Select Custom AI Model** to select a downloaded offline model file (`.bin` or `.litertlm` converted for MediaPipe LLM Inference, e.g. Gemma 2B or Phi-2).
• Revert to Standard AI: Go to **Settings > AI & Automation > Revert to Standard AI** to switch back to the built-in lightweight keyword & RAG engine.
• Privacy Guarantee: All AI execution happens 100% offline in RAM. No prompt or vault data is ever transmitted over the network.

title: Manage Profiles & Multiple Identities
content:
Isolate personal, work, and family vaults using Profiles in **Settings > Manage Profiles**:

• How to Create Profile: Go to **Settings > Manage Profiles** and tap the '+' (Add Profile) button at the top right.
• Switch Active Profile: Tap the profile avatar in the navigation bar or top header to switch active profile instantly.
• Custom Profile Pictures: Set a custom photo for each profile. After uploading, use the circular cropping tool to adjust the image.
• Official ID Exports: (Premium) Download profile pictures formatted in official Passport or Stamp sizes for physical document applications.
• Data Transfer: Transfer all data between profiles via **Settings > Data Management > Transfer Data**.

title: PhotoVault & Media Gallery Guide
content:
Manage private encrypted photos, videos, and documents in Media Gallery:

• Navigation & View Modes: Use the bottom navigation bar to switch between Gallery, Albums, Camera, People (AI face sorting), and Memories. Toggle between Grid, Gallery, Compact, and List view modes.
• Category Filter Pills: Filter instantly by All, Images, Videos, Documents, or Audio at the top of the gallery.
• Redesigned Document Cards: Seamless Material 3 document and file cards with clean unified containers across Light and Dark themes.
• Creation & Import Tools: Tap '+' or Camera button for Secret Snap (capture encrypted photo directly to vault), Scan Document, File Import, Import ZIP, or AutoScan Folders.
• Batch Tools & Export ZIP: Select multiple items to Export ZIP (with customizable compression), Scrub EXIF Metadata, Move to Recycle Bin, Add to Album, or Play Slideshow.
• Creative Tools: Photo Collage (combine up to 9 photos), Milestone Storyboard, and Multi-Clip Video Merger & Timeline Editor.
• Fast Scroll & Date Jump: Use the draggable scroll handle or section dropdown to jump to specific dates or months instantly.

title: Enabling & Using Autofill Service
content:
Vault automatically fills passwords, credit card numbers, and addresses in Chrome and Android apps:

1. Enable Service: Go to **Settings > Security > Autofill Service** and tap 'Enable'. Select 'Vault' as your preferred Android Autofill Service.
2. Usage: When opening a login or checkout page in Chrome or an app, Vault displays a suggestion banner. Tap it, authenticate with biometrics, and Vault fills the fields.
3. Offer to Save: When logging into a new app or site, Vault prompts to save new credentials directly to your active profile.
4. Save Offer Toggles: In **Settings > Security**, toggle 'Offer to save passwords', 'Offer to save cards', and 'Offer to save addresses' individually.

title: Vault Entry Actions & Features
content:
Manage individual vault records using quick-action tools:

• Visibility Toggle: Tap the 'Eye' icon to reveal or mask passwords, PINs, and card numbers.
• Smart Copy: Tap copy icons to send username, password, or account number to clipboard. Vault clears clipboard automatically after 30 seconds.
• Edit & Duplicate: Tap the Pencil icon to update or Duplicate icon to clone an entry.
• Share & QR Code: Generate an encrypted QR code for device-to-device scanning or share as an encrypted file.
• Smart Document Scanner & A4 Merge: (Premium) Scan ID cards and merge front/back photos into a single printable A4 document.

title: Vault Premium Benefits
content:
Unlock the full power of Vault with a 1-time lifetime Premium upgrade:

• Unlimited Items & Media: Store unlimited passwords, cards, notes, photos, and media without restrictions.
• 10 Isolated Profiles: Create up to 10 independent vaults (Free limit: 2).
• Bento Grid & Dual-Hub Layouts: Access high-density Bento Grid and Dual-Hub home screen layouts.
• Stealth Disguise & Decoy Vault: Disguise icon as a Calculator and create fake decoy vaults.
• Intruder Selfie Alerts: Front-camera photo capture on failed login attempts.
• Custom AI LLMs: Plug in custom offline LLM models (`.bin` or `.litertlm`).
